name: Wild Community Crafting Table Benchmark
description: Realistic, unstructured community guide table for legendary precursor crafting across Nevermore, H.O.P.E., Astralaria, Sunrise, and Mystic Tribute containing compound cells, natural language abbreviations, and zero database IDs.

columns.semantic_role: Collection tier classification and progressive collection step title
columns.description: The community-facing collection journey tier or crafting step name for precursor progression.

columns.semantic_role: Primary synthesized or acquired item entity (precursor, gift, or legendary weapon)
columns.description: The specific item produced by the step, whether an intermediate precursor, legendary gift, or final weapon.

columns.semantic_role: Compound collection of ingredient items and discrete numerical quantities
columns.description: Multi-ingredient cell containing quantity-prefixed material names joined by plus delimiters.

columns.semantic_role: Artisan trade discipline and minimum skill rating prerequisite
columns.description: Compound cell combining trade discipline (Artificer, Huntsman, Weaponsmith) and required skill level (0-500) or em-dash for non-artisan sources.

columns.semantic_role: NPC vendor merchant, world boss event encounter, or Mystic Forge venue with map zone
columns.description: Compound provenance descriptor combining NPC vendor / encounter with the geographic map zone.

columns.semantic_role: Direct vendor purchase expense or recipe unlocks in coins, karma, spirit shards, or barter tokens
columns.description: Mixed monetary expressions including gold/silver, karma, spirit shards, and map tokens.

columns.semantic_role: Informational gameplay flags, account binding status, mastery prerequisites, and recipe classifications
columns.description: Player-written annotations describing mastery requirements, account binding, and recipe mechanics.

expected_relations.description: Connects target item to each decomposed component item required to forge or craft it.
Connects target item recipe to the artisan discipline required (Artificer, Huntsman, Weaponsmith).
Connects target item recipe to the numerical crafting discipline skill rating threshold (e.g. 400, 450, 500).
Connects target item or recipe collection to the NPC vendor who provides it.
Connects the vendor NPC or encounter venue to the geographic map zone where it is situated.
Connects target item acquisition to the required currency types and expenditure amounts.
